title: Split routes.py into focused modules
desc: The triplicated way-resolution pipeline has been consolidated into a shared _resolve_way helper, but routes.py is still ~1,900 lines mixing annotations, way editing, planning, and wormhole sharing in one blueprint. Splitting it into per-concern modules (annotations, way edits, planning, sharing) would improve navigability.

title: Speed up planning hot paths with native extensions
desc: The main bottlenecks are the Python _bresenham generator and _segment_cost in RRT* (called O(max_iter × neighbors) times), and the heapq loop in grid_astar. Recommended approach: (1) try @numba.njit on these inner loops first — zero build overhead, easy to toggle; (2) replace grid_astar with skimage.graph.route_through_array which is C-backed; (3) Cython or pybind11 only if numba is unacceptable for deployment. Full C/C++ rewrite is not justified given that numpy, cKDTree, and Shapely/GEOS are already native.

title: Elevation-aware planning costs
desc: Integrate DEM tiles and add a slope penalty term in PathGrid.fill so the planners avoid steep terrain, not just tagged obstacles.

title: Viewer undo/redo built on the existing change_log
desc: The annotation store already records ordered, timestamped change entries; exposing undo/redo in the UI would mostly be frontend work plus inverse operations for each change type.

title: Progress reporting for fetch_area via SocketIO
desc: The fetch task is polled over REST while a SocketIO channel already exists for telemetry — pushing progress (query, parse, save stages) would remove the polling and its 404-on-second-poll footgun.

title: Version the .mapdata format
desc: The JSON schema has no format_version field, so future changes cannot be detected or migrated, and way_from_dict hard-KeyErrors on files missing newer keys (the crossroads list already needed a .get band-aid). Fix: write a version marker and use .get defaults on load.

title: Injectable RNG for RRT*
desc: All sampling draws from the module-global random: planning failures from the viewer cannot be reproduced, concurrent Flask request threads interleave draws non-deterministically, and tests must hack the global seed. Fix: accept rng: random.Random | None in __init__ and thread it through.

title: Vectorize Way.to_pcd_points and smooth_path hot loops
desc: The polygon branch materializes a MultiPoint over the full bbox grid and filters point-by-point with prepared.contains (~1M Point objects for a 500×500 m barrier at density 2) — shapely.contains_xy does this vectorized with no object churn; the segment loop grows pcd_points with np.concatenate per segment (quadratic copying). smooth_path is a scalar triple-loop that vectorizes directly as a Jacobi iteration. Distinct from the backlogged native-extension item (which covers the RRT*/grid_astar raster loops).

title: Cache /api/mapdata responses
desc: Every call shallow-copies the cached map, re-applies all edits (recomputing crossroads_list via parse_intersections whenever any edit exists), and rebuilds the full GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Fix: cache the merged GeoJSON keyed on (mapdata mtime, annotation-store hash), or serve an ETag and honor If-None-Match.

title: Pin ruff to one version across CI, pre-commit, and dev extras
desc: CI installs unpinned latest ruff while pre-commit pins v0.11.13 — this drift already caused the ruff-0.16 reformat churn commits. Pin the [dev] extra and CI to the pre-commit rev (or bump all three together).

title: CI tightening: strict docs build, demo smoke on PRs, enforced coverage
desc: mkdocs build lacks --strict, so broken links deploy silently; the viewer demo smoke test runs only on push to master, discovering breakage post-merge; coverage is measured but has no --cov-fail-under and is never published; ci.yml lacks workflow_dispatch. All small YAML changes.

title: Delete dead code and misleading names in the geometry/planner helpers
desc: points_to_graph_points and increase_line have no callers (and the offset-row distance metric adds parallel and perpendicular components linearly — wrong if ever revived); RRT*'s _is_collision segment branch is unreachable; GOAL_SAMPLE_BIAS doubles as the unrelated traversable-cell sampling bias; the density parameter across geometry helpers actually means spacing (callers pass 1/density).

title: Route all viewer filename handling through one validated resolver
desc: GET endpoints call _safe_data_path but many mutating endpoints pass the raw filename straight to _annotation_path, which contains traversal only incidentally (via Path.stem) and never verifies the referenced .mapdata exists. Harmless today but inconsistent defense-in-depth. Related lifecycle nit: create_app has no idempotency guard — a second call double-starts the telemetry thread and re-inits the ROS node.

title: Repo hygiene batch
desc: Delete the stale todo_fixes_plan.md at the repo root (PR #12 merged, its fixes verified landed); drop the unused python3-joblib from package.xml; add .mypy_cache/ to .gitignore; consider a CI check asserting the version triplicated across pyproject.toml/package.xml/CITATION.cff stays in sync.

title: Cheap linter/typechecker wins
desc: mypy: add check_untyped_defs, warn_unused_ignores, warn_redundant_casts (none require stubs). ruff: add the RUF, C4, and PT rule families (PT is valuable given the ~3,000-line test suite).

title: Wire up or remove the node anti-tag mechanism
desc: parameters/anti_obstacle_tags.csv is loaded nowhere and parse_osm_nodes has no anti-tag override analogous to Way.is_barrier. Related: way_node_ids is built from all ways, so obstacle nodes sitting on any way (the normal OSM position for barrier=gate/bollard) are always skipped and never become obstacles — if intentional, document it.
